basis.step: Before any service changes, runs the new image once as an ECS task with --trax-drain and waits for what is busy to finish.
Rolls each service with MinimumHealthyPercent 100 and MaximumPercent 200: the new task starts beside the old one, which stops once the new one is healthy.
Turns on the ECS deployment circuit breaker with rollback: a version that never gets healthy is rolled back.
The load balancer's target group checks the hub's health endpoint and sends requests only to healthy tasks.
